lines: Of the one with practice that also is said (breathing force); not for that, by the same means as redemption of the dead, as possible, by means.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sābhyāsasya tadapyuktaṃ balāśvāsi na tatkṛte mṛtoddhāroditaireva yathāsaṃbhūti hetubhiḥ
